steps: Open #/workspace/monitoring and wait for [data-test-id="workspace-navigation"] to be visible
Hover [data-test-id="workspace-navigation"] [data-test-id="Content lists"] so its hover state shows

If the icon is not in the bottom part of the panel, adjust the crop region so the icon and a few neighbours are in frame.

caption: The Manage Webhooks window
preconditions: Same content lists as for content-lists/lists-overview.png

Two webhooks seeded by seed.py (CONTENT_LIST_WEBHOOKS): https://www.meridian-news.example/hooks/content-lists (enabled) and https://staging.meridian-news.example/hooks/content-lists (disabled, excludes 'Culture picks')
steps: Click [data-test-id="webhook-item"][data-test-value="https://staging.meridian-news.example/hooks/content-lists"] to open the edit panel
Wait for [data-test-id="webhook-edit-panel"] to show URL, Excluded lists ('Culture picks') and Enabled (off)
notes: x-large modal titled 'Manage Webhooks'. The disabled webhook carries a 'Disabled' label. Seeding the webhooks makes the server queue real POSTs to the .example addresses on every list change; they fail and are retried by Celery, which is harmless on the e2e stack. Create the webhooks after the lists so seeding the lists does not trigger them.
